ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description:
Every error code the API can return. Exported to OpenAPI as an enum, so the
frontend gets a TS union and `packages/i18n` must translate each one (type-checked).
Add a member here before raising a new code.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description:
Error attached to one input field (dot path of camelCase names, e.g. `items.0.title`).

`code` is an `ErrorCode` for domain errors raised with `field=…`, or a Pydantic error
type (`missing`, `string_too_short`, …) for request validation; `params` carries
values for interpolation (e.g. `{"min_length": 8}`).

FieldKey.title: FieldKey
FieldKey.description: Every fact a document can carry; clients label each one, so the list is part of the API.

FuelAdjustment.title: FuelAdjustment
FuelAdjustment.description: A proposal only: the new prices bind once both parties sign the addendum.

isOfficial.title: Isofficial
isOfficial.description: Synced from Petrolimex: read-only, it is the source of record.

InstrumentListItem.title: InstrumentListItem

Approval of a document Spider drafts itself (a contract or an addendum). Archive documents
and documents drafted by the counterparty are recorded after signing and have no review.
